figures.caption: The screening process of the destination sequence. The study performed three rounds of inducible expression and screening at different levels: well plates, shake flasks, and 5 L fermenters. The detection methods of each round were the inhibitory zone, MIC, and protein yield, respectively. In total, 3000 active transformants were obtained by the inhibitory zone experiment. The transformants with good inhibitory zone effects were selected for sequencing, and nine sequences were determined. After the MIC assay, three candidates were performed for high-density expression in a 5 L fermenter.
